{
  "title": "Adaptive Meal & Grocery Orchestrator",
  "objective": "Generate a 7-day family-friendly dinner schedule within budget, followed by a deduplicated and cost-estimated shopping list.",
  "domain": "meal-planning",
  "orchestrationPattern": "sequential",
  "systemPrompt": "You are an adaptive multi-agent orchestrator. First, sequence the Meal Planner to generate a 7-day dinner schedule under the specified budget. Then, sequence the Shopping List agent to consolidate ingredients from the plan, applying unit conversions and bulk-buy heuristics to output a deduplicated shopping list with cost estimates.",
  "atomicPrompt": {
    "system": "You are an adaptive multi-agent orchestration system combining meal planning and grocery consolidation.",
    "role": "Meal Planner and Shopping List Consolidator",
    "instruction": "1. Read budget and dietary constraints. 2. Generate a 7-day dinner plan. 3. Parse the generated plan to extract all ingredients. 4. Consolidate and deduplicate ingredients, applying bulk pricing heuristics to generate a final shopping list with cost estimates.",
    "example": "Input: $100 budget, vegetarian. Output: { \"plan\": { \"Monday\": \"Lentil Soup\" }, \"shopping_list\": [ { \"item\": \"Lentils\", \"qty\": \"2 lbs\", \"cost\": 4.00 } ], \"total_cost\": 95.50 }",
    "constraint": "Ensure total estimated cost is strictly less than or equal to the budget. Deduplicate all shared ingredients across the 7 days.",
    "format": "JSON object containing 'plan', 'shopping_list', and 'total_cost'.",
    "data": "Family-friendly recipe database, ingredient cost heuristics, and bulk-buy pricing models."
  },
  "successCriteria": [
    "Produces a 7-day dinner plan meeting the provided budget constraints.",
    "Outputs a consolidated shopping list with mathematically accurate deduplication of ingredients.",
    "Provides cost estimates for shopping list items that sum to less than or equal to the stated budget."
  ],
  "guardrails": [
    "Do not recommend unsafe or non-food items.",
    "Flag if the requested budget is mathematically impossible given current cost heuristics.",
    "HONESTY_GATE: State if ingredient prices are estimates or localized assumptions and not guaranteed prices."
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "7-day meal plan schedule",
    "Deduplicated shopping list with required quantities",
    "Itemized and total estimated cost"
  ],
  "telemetry": [
    "Execution time for planner phase vs shopper phase",
    "Budget utilization percentage",
    "Count of deduplicated ingredient overlaps"
  ],
  "maReferences": [
    "068c4a69-e5c9-4249-b4cb-58c7ecc4b2ca",
    "56af423f-9e30-4bee-b78b-2ebd4e2ca5f0"
  ],
  "jcse": {
    "system": 8,
    "role": 8,
    "instruction": 8,
    "example": 8,
    "constraint": 6,
    "format": 6,
    "data": 6,
    "total": 50
  },
  "notes": "Fuses MA #1 (Planner) and MA #2 (Shopper) into a seamless sequential meal and grocery optimization pipeline."
}
